legend_note: Percentage change in QJXA — the year's highest daily mean river flow — at +2.7 °C against 1976–2005. It measures how much bigger river floods get, not who is in their way: pair it with the flood-plan and flood-zone layers for that. Grey is the minority where peaks fall. A daily mean, so it misses flash floods on small catchments. Explore2 models aggregated to communes by RARE; the popup carries the model spread, which is wide.
